name: Barter
description: Show what an NPC has for sale.

source.description: The NPC to open their barter menu.

prompt: If you sell things for a living and the player wants to trade, begin your response with '{key}:' to show them what you have for sale. A merchant is glad of a customer, stranger or not, and only refuses to trade with someone who has done something terrible to them or their family. If you are not a merchant, you have no wares to show.
